environment_lock.definition: Same multi-arch manifest-list digest; identical in-container tool versions (python3, GNU coreutils sort/wc/sha256sum, gzip, glibc); same engine commit (checkpoint workflow_git_sha) with workflow_git_dirty=false; per-platform image ids recorded but expected to differ.

freeze_statement: This manifest is committed before the first run of the frozen corpus. No cross-arm outcome of this corpus was examined before this commit. The 2026-11-19 OS-confounded field observation and the 2026-11-20 native-amd64-vs-qemu-emulated-arm64 container observation are different, report-local operational measurements; they are not this corpus and did not set any value below. A pre-data harness revision (CROSSARCH_STAGE=0 pre-staged image path) was committed before any workflow artifact existed; see harness_revision. A second pre-data harness revision (workflow-stem mapping) was committed after the first complete two-arm run produced evidence that the analysis could not pair; no cross-arm comparison was made and the raw evidence is preserved under attempt-2-stem-mismatch/.

governance.publication_gate: PR-05 C4 independent reviewer sign-off is PENDING. Per PR-05, no result may be described as pre-registered or confirmatory until that row is completed. The governed category is computed under the frozen rule and reported with this limitation; it is not a publication-ready confirmatory result.

harness_revision.commit: the commit that introduces this revision (recorded in the campaign report and campaign.log)
harness_revision.outcome_exposure: None; no workflow artifact existed before this revision.
harness_revision.reason: Docker Desktop 4.94 crashed on `docker rmi` of the digest-only reference during the first staging attempt. No workflow artifact was produced; the identity-only attempt is preserved under docs/superpowers/audits/data/crossarch-1397/attempt-1-docker-stopped/. The arm script now supports CROSSARCH_STAGE=0 (operator pre-staged image, fail-closed architecture verification) and the orchestrator pre-stages without `docker rmi`.

harness_revision_2.commit: the commit that introduces this revision (recorded in the campaign report and campaign.log)
harness_revision_2.outcome_exposure: No cross-arm comparison was made. The first run raw evidence was preserved but not analyzed as the campaign result.
harness_revision_2.reason: The first complete two-arm run named per-workflow evidence files by the .oxoflow file basename (cross-arch-provenance-governed-a) instead of the frozen workflow name (crossarch-governed-a), so the analysis could not pair the evidence. The outputs and checkpoints themselves were intact and were NOT compared; the run is preserved under docs/superpowers/audits/data/crossarch-1397/attempt-2-stem-mismatch/. The arm script now derives the stem from the workflow declared [workflow] name, matching the frozen corpus keys.

negative_control.role: excluded from the primary endpoint and every class statement; must differ across arms; identical output makes the campaign INVALID (harness failure)

outcome_exposure: None. No cross-arm run of this frozen corpus existed before this manifest.

thresholds.primary_endpoint: architecture-stable artifact proportion (artifacts with identical SHA-256 in both arms / artifacts produced in both arms)
thresholds.threshold_derivation: With N=24 and all artifacts identical, the exact lower bound is Beta.ppf(0.025, 24, 1) = 0.025^(1/24) = 0.857526, which clears tau_ARCH=0.80. The threshold is a campaign-level capability floor fixed by the planned N and the exact interval construction, not by an observed outcome.

validity_conditions: any missing primary artifact in either arm (missingness limit 0%)
any in-arm provenance verify mismatch or recorded-vs-independent hash mismatch
environment-lock mismatch: manifest-list digest, in-container tool version, engine commit, or dirty workflow tree
